name: Gurilynia
sum: Large Maastrichtian enantiornithine from Mongolia known from fragmentary bones.
wsnote: About 53 cm long and 23.2 cm at the hip, the largest Mongolian Mesozoic bird (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: PIN 4499-12, the proximal end of a right humerus.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Kurochkin 1999

sources.text: E. N. Kurochkin. 1999. A new large enantiornithid from the Upper Cretaceous of Mongolia. Trudy Zoologicheskogo Instituta 277:130-141
